source.behavior: Open/render the authenticated account email settings route. The source keeps saved SMTP passwords encrypted and never displays them after saving.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: Render the production workspace shell for the active authenticated tenant member without serializing email configuration or secret material in the route response.

authorization.idor_surface: Only the tenant route parameter is caller supplied; no user, site, provider, secret, or password identifier is accepted.

secrets_boundary.source_semantics: Saved SMTP passwords are encrypted and are represented only as a saved-password boolean in the source UI; they are never displayed after saving.
secrets_boundary.route_semantics: The adapted GET route returns only the application shell and does not read, serialize, log, or expose SMTP/provider credentials.
secrets_boundary.csrf: No mutation occurs on this GET route; Laravel web-session CSRF protections remain applicable to separate mutation endpoints.

tenant_isolation.proof: Tenant context resolution and TenantAuthorizer fail closed: a member without tenant.view receives 403 and a member of another tenant cannot resolve the foreign tenant route and receives 404.

semantics.queue_cache_scheduler: not used by this route operation
semantics.wordpress_connector: not used by this route operation
semantics.ai_provider: not used by this route operation
semantics.success_truthfulness: 200 only after session, tenant context, and RBAC authorization; otherwise redirect/403/404 fail closed.

scope: Exactly one canonical operation is closed by this evidence. Account email settings visible controls remain independently PENDING until separately claimed and proven.
